description: This file contains utility functions for mapping statuses and categories to specific colors for visualizing statuses with consistent, high-contrast colors across dark backgrounds. It includes color generation based on string hashing and status-to-color mappings aligned with a theme palette.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel-like HSL color from an input string, ensuring distinct hues for different strings while maintaining saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps a status string to a theme color; for known statuses like success, failure, or processing, returns theme-specific colors; for unknown or unspecified statuses, returns a deterministic pastel color based on the string.
